service.description: Set a room's disappearing messages: seconds from 30 to 2419200 (4 weeks), 0 or empty for off. Any member of a direct room, a moderator or owner of another. New messages only. A change is a system event {action: timer, seconds, byUserId} and a room change in the members' feeds. Refused (reasonCode): notAllowed, range, archived, recordRoom (a record's room keeps its history), bridged (a mapping in force, or a phone room: a bridge cannot delete on its network), federated.

Open a view-once message (a current member who did not send it): its file (chatAttachmentId, fileName, contentType, fileSize) is served by get#ViewOnceFile until until, 2 minutes after the first open, at most 3 times. The first open is a change of the message (the sender's Opened). Once every recipient opened it, its file goes at the end of that window, and it stands as Opened. Refused (reasonCode): sender, opened (after the window), gone (the file went).

The file of a view-once message, for the download transition (which sends the location, not cached): for a recipient in the window of their open#ViewOnce, each download counted (3 at most). Else not found.

The due events (expireDate at or before now), up to limit (chat_expiry_round_limit, 2000), each room by expire#RoomMessages in its own transaction: one that fails is logged, and its events are still due next time; it is skipped on this node for 5 minutes (the cache chat.expiry.failed), so it holds no round back. The expiry worker runs it at the next due time; the daily clean#ChatRetention runs it too. more: there are more due now (the worker runs again at once).

parameter.name: skippedCount
parameter.description: Rooms skipped as they failed lately on this node (5 minutes)

service.description: Internal: a room's due events, with its row locked. A message goes with what clear#MessageContent clears, the preview cache rows of its links that no other message links, its view-once opens and its room changes; an edit, reaction or redaction of it goes too. A thread root that stands gets its count and last reply, the room its last message. In an encrypted room, a Megolm session no event of the room has any more leaves every user's key backup. A view-once message everyone opened loses only its file, and stands as Opened until its own time. One room change, eventSeq empty {cause: expired, before}, says every event due at or before before is gone; the members get their counts and the push {kind: expired, chatRoomId, before, eventSeqList}.
Internal: wake this node's expiry worker after the commit, for an event due at dueMillis.
